notes.title: Sporty Peppers - The Grande Cause Nationale Update
notes.content:
Sporty Peppers is getting a makeover with this major update bringing the following improvements:

Our new game "Sprint Racers":
Run to move forward, jump across the hedges and duck to dodge obstacles.

New features:
[list]
[*] Game modes: Challenge and Training.
[*] Quick Play
[*] Online ranking.
[*] Local ranking.
[*] Character selection.
[*] Level selection: Athletics, Retro and levels in the colors of our partners.
[*] Game settings:
- motion detection sensitivity
- difficulty setting
- obstacle number setting
- choice of distance or time mode
[*] Improved motion detection
[*] Photobooth mode: take a photo with your medal and score after a race and share it with your friends!
[/list]

Coming soon: improvements to our other games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648862/0ec1b84cb16307857182c548eaa38c10b14b4e64.png[/img]

notes.title: December update
notes.content:
The December update is live!

🧙 Grab the golden pepper treasure in [b]Golden Run[/b]! 
Be the first to reach the center of the arena by running, jumping over the gaps and ducking to avoid the magic spheres sent by the wizard guarding the treasure.

✨ Overall UI improvement.

🔧 Fixed bugs and improved the stability of the game.

notes.title: Update notes for March 22.
notes.content:
Every day we work to make the experience as smooth as possible for you!
We are sorry for the bugs that some of you had on the previous version. 

We have fixed as soon as possible:
[list]
[*] Improved recognition in the games Winter Rush and Golden Run
[*] Corrections in the interface (button / language, etc.)
[/list]

For any questions / remarks, we are at your disposal:
[url=https://www.sportypeppers.com/#contact]https://www.sportypeppers.com/#contact[/url]

notes.title: Updates notes for 22nd December
notes.content:
We fixed several bugs in the game!!

You can now flash the QR code at the end of Fast Libero, Winter Rush and Golden Run to download the app on your telephone and test our mobile games!

[url=https://linktr.ee/sportypeppers]Find us and follow us on social networks for new exciting features and a challenge with awesome gifts starting soon![/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 13th October 2022
notes.content:
Every day we work to enhance your gaming experience!   

We are delighted to support the Telethon gaming! For the occasion: Fast Libero and Winter Rush are in the colors of the Telethon. And all our games can be played with the upper body!
